# 金剛經持驗記

**ID:** X1635
**Volume:** X87
**Category:** 史傳部類
**Original Category:** 史傳部／感應神異傳
**Byline:** 清 周克復纂
**Dynasty:** 清
**Date:** 1644–1911
**Juans:** 2
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/X1635

## Contributors
- 周克復 (A000558)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A 2-juan early-Qīng anthology of *Diamond Sūtra* miracle-tales, compiled by the Yíxīng lay-Buddhist scholar **Zhōu Kèfù** 周克復 (*hào* **Tóngshàn dàorén** 同善道人) of **Jīngxī** 荊溪 (Yíxīng, Jiāngsū), edited by his son **Zhōu Shí** 周石 and reviewed by **Chén Jìshēng** 陳濟生 *Huángshì* 皇士 of **Wúmén** 吳門. The full title used in the work itself is **《歷朝金剛持驗紀》** *Lìcháo Jīngāng chíyàn jì* ("Dynasty-by-Dynasty Records of Verified Diamond-Sūtra Upholding"), reflecting its **chronologically-organised** structure — beginning from the Northern Wèi and proceeding through the dynasties to the **昭代** 昭代 (the present Qīng). The work is one of **five** *chíyàn jì* anthologies compiled by Zhōu Kèfù — together with the **《法華經持驗記》** [KR6r0072](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6r/KR6r0072), **《觀音經持驗記》** [KR6r0073](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6r/KR6r0073), **《華嚴經持驗記》** [KR6r0089](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6r/KR6r0089), and the **《淨土晨鐘》** *Jìngtǔ chénzhōng* — forming his comprehensive project of dynasty-by-dynasty miracle-anthologies for the principal late-imperial scripture-cult sūtras. Transmitted in the Xùzàngjīng as X1635.

**Abstract**

The work catalogues approximately **150 miracle-tales** dynasty-by-dynasty, drawing on:
- The Tang Mèng Xiànzhōng tradition (via [KR6r0174](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6r/KR6r0174)).
- The Tang Duàn Chéngshì tradition (via [KR6r0175](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6r/KR6r0175)).
- The Sòng *Tàipíng guǎngjì* tradition (via [KR6r0176](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6r/KR6r0176)).
- The Míng Wáng Qǐlóng tradition (via [KR6r0178](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6r/KR6r0178)).
- Contemporary Qīng cases drawn from Zhōu Kèfù's own informant network — including, notably, a Yíxīng Buddhist matron's *Diamond Sūtra* recitation in **Kāngxī 5 = 1666**.

The work's **principal contribution** beyond its predecessors is its **systematic historical-philological apparatus**: each tale is footnoted to its source, ambiguous cases are noted, and the editorial *fánlì* makes explicit the methodological standards. Zhōu Kèfù's compilation is therefore not merely a devotional anthology but also a **scholarly recension** of the *Diamond Sūtra* miracle-tradition.

The dating bracket — **1659 to 1680** — is fixed by the dating of Zhōu Kèfù's companion **《淨土晨鐘》** to **Shùnzhì 16 = 1659** and the inclusion of **Kāngxī**-era cases (the Kāngxī 5 = 1666 reference cited above).
